Twenty-one comments

The Tune

One of mine that just came out of nowhere today. My 12 year old son and I were getting ready to play a few tunes today and I said… “you take that chair” and then I said “Ill take this chair… the fiddler’s chair.”

↳ Posted by The Merry Highlander on March 4th, 2007.

It’s nice! For me there’s not enough repetition in the phrases for it to hang together as a single reel though, and when I played it through it naturally came together as a double. Maybe I’m just not getting it, but here’s how I played it:

X: 1
T: Fiddler’s Chair, The
M: 4/4
L: 1/8
R: reel
K: Gmaj
~B2Ac BG~G2|DEFG ABcA|GEED ~E3d|edBG A2GA|
~B2Ac BG~G2|DEFG ABcA|GEED ~E2Bd|1 edBA ~G2A:|2 edBA ~G3d||

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on March 5th, 2007.

That last G of the 1st time thru the A part I should have written as ~G3.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on March 5th, 2007.

Dow

Thanks for the comments. I orginally thought it should be a double but posted it as a single for simplicity. I really like your arrangement and feel that you captured the essence of the tune. I would probably play it as a double and similar to what you posted. (but with less ornamentation) I am not one to play anything the same way twice and I enjoy playing with ending phrases, so I I think what you did with it is fantastic. So I’d say you got it.

This tune was not work at all to compose, It just came to me and I thought it was a keeper. I posted hoping at least one person would enjoy it… otherwise I might forget it!

↳ Posted by The Merry Highlander on March 5th, 2007.

I just tried it again today, and I could remember it after only playing it through a couple of times yesterday. I really love it. It’s worth sifting through all the crap here in the tunes section to find gems like this. I’d love to try and introduce it to the people at my session.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on March 5th, 2007.

Thanks.

I sincerely appreciate your comments… Feel free to play it and share it with others.

↳ Posted by The Merry Highlander on March 6th, 2007.

I enjoyed following that and playing along… Thanks… It took my mind off the fact I burnt the hell out of my lip, and burnt some of what I had in the oven too. I knew better. I had some left over batter and just threw it into Yorkshire pudding molds and it was half the thickness of the main, and then, knowing I should have tossed it in halfway through the baking time, I slid it into the bottom. I was singing this when it happened. I don’t know whether to try to cast the blame your way or MH’s? :-(
